As a pool grows and matures, its yield naturally stabilizes. You can see this live curve playing out right now across GalaSwap’s 0.3% fee tier pools:

How much liquidity can the SOL/BTC pool actually hold before compressing to ordinary DeFi rates?

SOL/BTC isn't just a proof of concept anymore. It’s the live demo. 🟡

Ever since October 7, 2023, I shifted to reporting the news 24/7. That season culminated during the major milestones of this ongoing war - the hostage crisis, the pager operation, the fall of the Assad regime, and the two wars with Iran.

The sheer amount of evil I was exposed to - most of which I deliberately chose not to share - combined with increasing sleep deprivation and chronic back pain, eventually forced me to make a very difficult decision.

I had to ask myself one simple question: What is my true calling?

The answer was clear: to teach the Word of God.

As long as I could faithfully teach the Scriptures while also keeping you informed with the news, I gladly did both. Over the past several weeks, and particularly in recent days, as I witnessed the complete madness, deception, and confusion coming from every direction, I realized the time had come to make the painful decision to step away from daily news reporting.

I knew there would be backlash, and sadly, I was right. My direct messages on Instagram quickly became vicious, mean-spirited, and hostile. One woman told me she was going to throw my books in the trash instead of giving them to her brother to read. Others warned that this decision would financially hurt the ministry.

Looking back now, I can honestly acknowledge that I am dealing with post-traumatic stress from everything I was exposed to while covering these events.

When you’re in that state, reporting the news becomes nearly impossible. Your emotions begin to overwhelm your thoughts and judgment, and before you even realize it, your personal frustration and grief over what is happening in the world begin to shape the tone of your reporting. Instead of informing, equipping, and encouraging, I found myself increasingly doing the opposite.

I am deeply grateful that I was able to serve in that capacity during one of the darkest periods in Israel’s history. But I am even more grateful that God has allowed me to recognize my own weakness and vulnerability, and to return wholeheartedly to the place where I know I belong - studying and teaching His Word.

News will never lead anyone to the saving knowledge of the Messiah, nor will it ultimately explain the world we live in. The Word of God will.

And as for me, the verse the Lord has placed on my heart is this:

“And He said to me, ‘My grace is sufficient for you, for My strength is made perfect in weakness.’ Therefore most gladly I will rather boast in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.”
2 Corinthians 12:9 (NKJV)

Awaiting His Return,

Amir

That bridge is a critical node on the International North–South Transport Corridor, the overland artery tying Iran to Central Asia, Russia — and more and more to China. 

Iranian media kindly did the strategic mapping: Russia has been routing its exports through this line since November, and Chinese freight traffic on the corridor has tripled since the naval choke in Hormuz shut the “wet” route.

The same morning, authorities quietly delayed the funeral ceremony for Khamenei in Mashhad by several hours. Official excuse: “the ceremony in Karbala was extended due to the large number of participants.” Apparently geopolitics now travels by train.

Israeli channels rushed to mock the strike: the bridge, they claimed, could be repaired “in a few hours with 200 workers,” and the whole thing was “for show.” 

Maybe. But a state that publicly calls this bridge its trade lifeline to two major powers, then stops rail traffic to the city where it’s burying its supreme leader because that bridge was hit, does not act like it’s dealing with theater. It acts like someone just punched through its logistics spreadsheet.

Not only are boats, piers, and coastal radars fair game — the dry corridor that replaces blocked sea lanes is too. The target list now includes the route that lets Iran, Russia, and China pretend they’ve found a clean detour around American pressure.

❗️ What is the Coinbase Premium Index? U.S. Bitcoin demand gauge 

➡️ One number tells you whether United States institutions are buying Bitcoin or backing away: the gap between the price on Coinbase and the price on the rest of the world’s exchanges. Here is how the Coinbase Premium Index works, why it moved markets in 2026, and how to read it without fooling yourself.

⚠️ Every market has a tell. In Bitcoin, one of the most watched is almost embarrassingly simple: the same coin trades on hundreds of venues at once, and the price is never exactly the same everywhere. Most of those gaps are noise. One of them is a signal, because of who trades where.

🔖 Coinbase is the exchange of record for regulated American money. Hedge funds, corporate treasuries, registered advisors, and, most importantly, the custodial and trading infrastructure behind the United States spot Bitcoin ETFs all route disproportionately through it. Binance and the other global venues carry everyone else. When Bitcoin trades richer on Coinbase than on the global market, someone in the American regulated system is paying up to buy. When it trades cheaper, that bid is gone, or has turned into supply.
